error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the camera. Check the host/port.

abort.wrong_camera: This is a different camera than the one being reconfigured.

create_preset.name: Create preset
create_preset.description: Save the camera's current PTZ position as a preset (slot + name). The preset list refreshes automatically.

device_id.name: Camera
device_id.description: The Dahua camera to save the preset on.

name.name: Preset name
name.description: Name shown in the Preset select.

preset_number.name: Preset number
preset_number.description: Slot 1-255. Leave empty to reuse the slot with the same name, or the lowest free slot. An occupied slot is overwritten. Check used slots with Get presets or the Preset entity's attributes (presets / free_slots).

get_presets.name: Get presets
get_presets.description: Read the camera's preset list (slot number + name) and the lowest free slots. Use it before Create preset to avoid overwriting a slot.

device_id.name: Camera
device_id.description: The Dahua camera to read presets from.

delete_preset.name: Delete preset
delete_preset.description: Delete the preset stored in a slot. Check slot numbers with Get presets first.

device_id.name: Camera
device_id.description: The Dahua camera to delete the preset from.
